entities.summary: Old Order Mennonites form a branch of the Mennonite tradition. Old Order are those Mennonite groups of Swiss German and south German heritage who practice a lifestyle without some elements of modern technology, wear very conservative and modest dress, and have retained the old forms of worship, baptism and communion. A majority of Old Order Mennonite still drive a horse and buggy, whereas a large minority use cars.
